name: gitlab-mcp-server
description: Manage GitLab projects, issues, merge requests, pipelines, repositories, and admin workflows from Claude.
long_description:
Comprehensive GitLab MCP server covering the full REST API v4 and GraphQL with automatic edition gating — ~847 tools on Free/CE, ~999 on Premium, up to ~1071 on Ultimate.

By default it exposes a low-token dynamic surface (two find/execute tools) so it never crowds your context window; a consolidated meta-tool mode (~32 domain tools) and a one-tool-per-action individual mode are selectable in the extension settings. Bundles 45 MCP resources, 37 prompts, argument completions, progress notifications, elicitation, and resource subscriptions (live change notifications for 26 resource kinds, honored by polling).

Works with GitLab.com and self-managed instances. Read-only and safe (mutation-preview) modes are available for cautious use.

tools.name: gitlab_find_action
tools.description: Discover GitLab actions with a natural-language query and get their exact input schemas.

tools.name: gitlab_execute_action
tools.description: Execute any catalog GitLab action (projects, issues, MRs, pipelines, admin, …) by canonical id with typed parameters.

gitlab_url.title: GitLab URL
gitlab_url.description: GitLab instance URL. Keep https://gitlab.com for SaaS, or set your self-managed instance URL.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab Personal Access Token
gitlab_token.description: Personal Access Token (glpat-…) with `api` scope. Create one under GitLab → User Settings → Access Tokens.

tool_surface.title: Tool surface
tool_surface.description: Tool catalog surface: "dynamic" (two find/execute tools, lowest token use — recommended), "meta" (~32 consolidated domain tools) or "individual" (one tool per action).

gitlab_tier.title: GitLab tier
gitlab_tier.description: Force the licensing tier ("free", "premium" or "ultimate") and skip license detection. Leave empty to auto-detect from the instance license.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Disable every mutating tool. Safe for exploration and review-only sessions.

safe_mode.title: Safe mode
safe_mode.description: Mutating tools return a JSON preview of the request instead of executing it.

skip_tls_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
skip_tls_verify.description: Allow self-signed certificates on self-managed instances. Leave off unless you need it.
